label: For "Proactive Outage Notification & Credits": Notify affected customers of outages in their own channel with accurate restoration estimates and calculate goodwill credits within policy, so contacts during incidents fall. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Notifying by postcode.
